question.prompt: Where is the intersection of the lines containing the three altitudes of an obtuse triangle?

solutions.explanation: The lines containing the three altitudes of a triangle intersect at one point. For an acute triangle, this point is inside the triangle; for a right triangle, it is at the right-angle vertex; and for an obtuse triangle, it is outside the triangle.
solutions.title: Location of the altitude intersection
